newsitem.title: JAPAN: LDP panel says will recommend govt raise rates.
newsitem.headline: LDP panel says will recommend govt raise rates.

text.p: The ruling Liberal Democratic Party's (LDP) administrative reform panel said on Friday it will recommend that the Japanese government raise interest rates in the future.

Asked if the panel planned to make a specific recommendation to the government for an interest rate increase, an official with the LDP reform panel told Reuters: "People are having a hard time as a result of low interest rates...We would like to call on the government to show more consideration to this situation."
He added that the government should give due consideration to depositors and pensioners who are being hurt by the low domestic interest rates.

But he said the LDP panel did not reach a conclusion on the timing of the recommendation and the extent of a possible rate hike, as the situation in the financial markets tends to change in the short term.
